papers.title: Rank Without an Oracle: Deviation-Aware Interaction-Rank Selection from Offline Multi-Agent Logs
papers.titleZh: 无须预言机的排序：从离线多智能体日志中进行偏差感知的交互秩选择
papers.abstract: Offline multi-agent payoff models are estimated under a logging distribution but used on distributions induced by learned solutions and unilateral deviations. Standard held-out loss can therefore favor an interaction class that predicts logged play well while distorting strategic incentives. We introduce Selective Interaction-Rank Validation (SIRV) for finite games with known logging distributions. A training split fits nested payoff models and constructs a common union of all candidate deployment and unilateral-replacement distributions; an independent calibration split evaluates every candidate on this same union. SIRV returns the smallest rank whose simultaneous upper worst-target risk is within tolerance of the best upper score, and abstains when a declared target is unsupported or too imprecisely estimated. A common coverage event yields a finite-candidate target-risk bound and a candidate-specific coarse correlated equilibrium (CCE) gap certificate. We also isolate an exact two-point off-support non-identifiability result. In a controlled factorial study with 2,048 independent games per family, empirical-Bernstein bounds reduce the median CCE-gap certificate by 42.5% relative to Hoeffding bounds on common returns, with a 1.36-point reduction in supported return. Under paired rank misspecification and in a separately generated congestion family, the SIRV-EB fallback rule lowers mean true candidate-selection CCE regret relative to ID-Mean, while retaining game-level losses. Across 384 games at $N=3,5,8$, ID-Mean-relative mean CCE-regret effects stay positive while certified return falls sharply under weak coverage. These results separate certifiable model selection from universal strategic improvement.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 传统离线多智能体学习使用留出损失评估模型，但这仅反映日志分布下的预测精度，无法衡量模型在策略部署和个体偏离时是否保持正确的激励结构。这导致可能选出在实际博弈中扭曲策略偏好的模型。本文提出，模型选择应关注其在候选策略及其单边偏离分布上的表现，而非仅仅拟合历史行为。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 研究设定在一个有限动作的正规型博弈中，智能体基于已知的日志分布v观察到动作与回报。每个候选模型对应一个交互秩k，通过嵌套的布尔单项式类拟合收益函数，并计算对应的粗略相关均衡（CCE）作为部署策略。关键创新在于构建一个由所有候选模型的混合策略及其单边替换策略构成的公共目标分布联合T。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文提出了选择性交互秩验证（SIRv），它在独立校准数据上同时评估所有候选模型在公共目标联合T上的平方风险上界。SIRv返回满足上界标准的最小秩，或在目标不被支持或估计不精确时拒绝选择。该方法提供了目标风险与CCE间隙证书的联合保证，并揭示了特定离支持点偏离的不可识别性。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 核心方法是利用训练数据固定目标联合T，使所有候选在同一组目标分布上接受检验，从而实现公平比较。通过profile-level的经验Bernstein或Hoeffding不等式构建同时置信区间，确保风险估计的可靠性。支持性决策基于已知日志概率，精度检查则依赖于校准样本量，共同决定是否拒绝输出。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 该方法依赖于有限动作空间和已知日志分布，难以直接扩展至连续动作或未知策略场景。其全局支持规则较为保守，可能拒绝仍有用的局部答案。尽管如此，SIRv清晰地分离了可验证的模型选择与普遍的战略改进，其关于目标局部性、拒绝机制与证书生成的设计对离线多智能体学习具有重要启示，值得深入研读其模型抽象与实证分析部分。

papers.title: Last-Iterate Convergence of Policy Dynamics in Zero-Sum Networked Separable Markov Games
papers.titleZh: 零和网络可分马尔可夫博弈中策略动态的末次迭代收敛性
papers.abstract: Solving Nash equilibria for general multi-player Markov games is computationally intractable, while two-player zero-sum Markov games admit fast last-iterate policy-optimization methods. Finite-horizon zero-sum networked separable Markov games occupy an important middle ground: they retain global competition structure through pairwise interactions, while preserving computational tractability of Nash equilibria (NE) in the full-information and known-transition setting. Existing algorithms for this class either proceed through equilibrium-collapse arguments for a simplified setting where a single controller determines the transition probability, or backward dynamic programming that relies on equilibrium solvers at each stage. However, the design and analysis of direct policy-update approaches remain inadequate. To address this issue, we propose the entropy-regularized optimistic multiplicative weights update (ER-OMWU), a complementary single-loop policy dynamic that updates players' policies symmetrically and returns an approximate NE in the last iteration. We provide a first last-iterate convergence analysis of policy dynamics in the games of interest: after $\widetilde{O}(1/ε)$ iterations, the returned policy is an $ε$-approximate Nash equilibrium. The result preserves the near-linear convergence rate achieved by policy optimization in two-player zero-sum Markov games, but extends the policy-dynamics viewpoint to a more complicated but structured multi-player setting.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 为什么在多玩家马尔可夫博弈中难以高效求解纳什均衡？因为一般情形下计算近似均衡是计算困难的。本文聚焦于一类结构化的零和网络可分博弈，这类博弈保留了多玩家竞争的局部交互特性，同时具备可处理的均衡结构。问题是：能否设计一种直接的策略更新方法，在不依赖阶段博弈求解的情况下实现末次迭代收敛？
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 作者考虑有限阶段、多玩家、零和且奖励与转移可分解为边交互的马尔可夫博弈。每个玩家仅通过图上的邻接关系与其他玩家发生效用交互，全局仍保持零和性质。转移机制允许控制器分离结构，涵盖无中心控制与单/多控制器情形。目标是学习一个近似纳什均衡策略组合。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 本文提出了熵正则化乐观乘法权重更新（ER-OMWU）算法，首次实现了此类博弈中策略动态的末次迭代收敛。在O(N²H³log A/ε)次迭代后，输出策略为ε-近似纳什均衡，收敛速率在精度ε上达到近乎线性的依赖，与二人零和马尔可夫博弈中的最优速率一致。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者结合了乐观策略更新与边级Q值追踪技术，通过KL散度收缩分析捕捉策略演化的稳定性，并利用向后递归的Q估计误差传播控制，最终将正则化均衡误差转化为纳什间隙上界。关键技术在于耦合策略更新与值估计的同步分析，避免了传统动态规划中反复求解阶段博弈。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 结果依赖于完全信息与已知模型设定，且控制器分离假设限制了转移结构的通用性。尽管如此，该工作首次将末次迭代收敛从二人博弈推广到结构化多人博弈，其单循环策略动态设计与分析框架对多智能体强化学习具有启发意义，值得细读其技术路线与证明结构。

papers.title: Strategyproof Mechanisms for Connecting Impassable Regions
papers.titleZh: 连接不可通行区域的策略证明机制
papers.abstract: We study strategyproof mechanisms for building a pathway between two regions of a line segment separated by an obstacle. Each of the $n$ agents has a private location within its region and may use either its original route to a facility or the new pathway, whose traversal cost is a fraction $k\in[0,1)$ of its length. We seek strategyproof (SP) and group-strategyproof (GSP) mechanisms that approximately minimize maximum cost or social cost. After characterizing optimal pathways for both objectives, we establish a tight deterministic maximum-cost approximation ratio of $\frac{2}{1+k}$ and a deterministic social-cost upper bound of $\frac{n}{1+k(n-1)}$, together with complementary lower bounds. Both upper bounds are achieved by GSP mechanisms. We then study randomized mechanisms under strategyproofness in expectation. A power-proportional mechanism achieves a social-cost approximation ratio at most $5$, independent of $n$ and $k$, with a tight guarantee of $3$ for this mechanism when $k=0$. We prove randomized lower bounds of $\frac{3+2k}{2+3k}$ for maximum cost and $\max\big\{1,\frac{285}{263+385k}\big\}$ for social cost, the latter for $n\ge7$. Finally, we improve several bounds for the real-line pathway model of [Chan and Wang, AAMAS 2023]. Our deterministic maximum-cost lower bound of $2$ matches the upper bound obtainable from [Qin, Fang, and Liu, COCOA 2024]. We strengthen the deterministic social-cost lower bound from $\frac32$ to $2$ under SP and to $\max\{2,n-1\}$ under GSP. For randomized social cost, we sharpen the guarantee of Chan and Wang's proportional mechanism from $6$ to $3$ and raise their lower bound from $1.02$ to $\frac{285}{263}\approx1.08365$ for $n\ge7$.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 当道路被障碍物（如自然灾害区或生态保护区）分隔时，如何通过建设连接路径提升跨区域可达性成为一个关键问题。传统路径规划忽略个体策略性行为，即人们可能谎报位置来影响路径端点选址。本文从机制设计角度切入，研究如何在代理人私有位置信息下设计激励相容的路径建设机制，填补了连接基础设施与策略行为交互的研究空白。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 模型考虑一条线段上的两个被障碍物隔开的区域，每个代理人在其中一个区域内拥有私有位置。目标是选择路径的两个端点以最小化社会总成本或最大个体成本。路径通行成本为长度乘以折扣因子k。代理人的成本取决于是否使用路径，并受其真实位置影响。机制需满足策略证明性，即无人可通过虚报位置获益，同时评估确定性和随机性机制的近似性能。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文给出了确定性机制在最大成本下的紧确近似比2/(1+k)，并提出CRITICAL EXTREME机制达到该界限且满足组策略证明性。对于社会成本，提出了TwoEXTREME机制及其近似上界，并建立了更强的下界。在随机机制方面，提出PowerProportional机制，在期望意义下实现独立于人数的社会成本近似比至多5，并在k=0时紧确达到3，显著优于已有结果。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者利用结构化最优路径分析，证明至少一个端点可设于原设施处，从而简化搜索空间。通过构造特定实例进行对抗论证，得出各情形下的下界。关键技术包括对成本函数的分段线性性质分析、基于代理人间接收益差异的概率采样机制设计，以及运用期望成本比较和不等式放缩完成近似比证明。随机机制的下界则借助多配置剖面与凸组合技巧建立。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 模型局限于单障碍线段场景，扩展至复杂网络仍具挑战。随机机制虽得恒定近似比，但上界与下界间仍有差距，尤其在k接近1时。结果高度依赖路径端点选择结构，难以直接推广到高维或多路径设置。然而，其对策略性位置报告与基础设施设计结合的深入分析，为后续研究提供了坚实基础，特别适合关注机制设计与路径优化交叉领域的读者精读。

papers.title: Strengthening Proportionality in Participatory Budgeting with Additive Utilities
papers.titleZh: 在具有加性效用的参与式预算中加强比例性
papers.abstract: Proportional representation is a central goal in participatory budgeting, where voters select public projects subject to a shared budget. Full justified representation (FJR) accounts for groups whose members may value different projects, but computing an FJR outcome is strongly NP-hard for additive utilities. We show that FJR up to one project can be achieved in polynomial time for arbitrary nonnegative additive utilities and project costs. Our approach extends Residual-Budget Greedy and satisfies a stronger fractional axiom that can also be verified in polynomial time. For approval utilities, this axiom coincides with FJR+, providing exact FJR in that setting. We further show that every feasible completion of the algorithm's selected set preserves the representation guarantee, providing flexibility in allocating the remaining budget. In particular, we give a completion that ensures priceability at the original budget. For unit-cost projects, we strengthen the representation guarantee to the Droop quota and combine it with priceability whenever there are enough positively valued projects to fill the budget.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 参与式预算是居民共同决定公共支出的过程，核心挑战是如何保障群体的比例代表性。当选民对项目的偏好不仅限于‘是否支持’，而是能表达不同强度的价值时，传统的批准效用模型不再充分。本文关注在加性效用下如何实现更强的比例代表，尤其是全正当代表（FJR）这一理想性质，但已知其计算极为困难。因此，问题聚焦于：能否设计一个既高效可算又能逼近FJR的机制？
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 模型设定包含一组选民和若干项目，每个项目有成本，总预算固定。每位选民对每个项目赋予非负的加性效用，目标是选出一个可行项目集合。群体若能负担某项目子集且每个成员对该子集有较高总效用，则至少一人应在最终结果中获得相应满足。关键在于如何定义‘满足’——FJR要求基于整个提案集的总效用而非单个项目最小值，这更合理但也更难处理。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文证明可在多项式时间内计算出满足‘FJR up to one project’（FJR1）的解，并进一步提出一个更强的分数性质FJR1+，该性质可多项式时间验证且蕴含FJR1。对于批准效用情形，FJR1+退化为已知的FJR+并精确满足FJR。此外，算法所选集合的所有可行扩展均保持此保障，且可通过特定补全过程实现价格合理性。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者扩展了残差预算贪心（RBG）算法，结合按效用比例支付与剩余代表需求的归一化因子。通过构造一个依赖剩余预算与赋予权重的势函数，利用线性规划验证FJR1+，并将验证简化为有限个特定效用水平上的检查。关键技巧是限制未选项目在已超额满足个体时的权重，从而确保松弛条件仍具经济意义。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 尽管FJR1+提供了强保证，但它仍是FJR的松弛版本，且算法依赖特定支付规则与顺序选择。结果未解决完全FJR的高效构造，也未涵盖动态或时序设置。然而，论文在比例性公理的可计算化路径上迈出关键一步，其分数松弛方法、验证框架与完成性分析对后续研究具有高阅读价值，尤其适合关注公平机制设计与算法社会选择的读者。

papers.title: The Complexity of Membership, Uniqueness, and Counting for Optimal Proportional Approval Voting Committees
papers.titleZh: 最优比例认可投票委员会的成员资格、唯一性和计数复杂性
papers.abstract: Proportional Approval Voting (PAV) chooses committees that maximize a sum of harmonic utilities. We study the set of maximizing committees: whether a candidate belongs to some or all of them, whether the optimum is unique, and how many optima exist. When the committee size is part of the input, the three decision problems are $Δ_2^\mathrm{P}$-complete. Uniqueness remains hard for instances with at most two optimal committees. Counting optimal committees is $\#\!\cdot\!\mathrm{OptP}$-complete under metric reductions: every function $f$ in this class reduces to an election with exactly $f(x)+1$ optimal committees. The reductions encode satisfying assignments directly as committees and use harmonic marginal rewards to realize binary objectives with polynomially many voters. Each satisfying assignment has a unique committee representation, and fixed clause ballots give these representations the same clause score. We also prove Turing equivalence with $\#\mathrm{SAT}$ and show that membership of the counting problem in $\#\mathrm{P}$ would imply $\\mathrm{NP}=\mathrm{coNP}$.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 比例认可投票（PAV）是一种旨在实现群体代表性的多候选人选举机制，但它可能选出多个得分相同的最优委员会。这引发了一个核心问题：哪些候选人必然或可能进入胜出委员会？最优解是否唯一？有多少个最优解？这些问题关乎选举结果的确定性与稳定性，现有研究仅知其难度下界，缺乏精确的复杂性分类。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 模型基于标准的认可投票框架：选民提交批准的候选人集合，PAV机制通过最大化调和效用总和来选择固定大小的委员会。研究关注的是所有达到最高PAV分数的委员会构成的集合。问题被形式化为三个决策任务：某候选人是否属于某个最优委员会、是否属于所有最优委员会、最优委员会是否唯一，以及一个计数任务：最优委员会的数量。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文给出了上述四个问题的精确复杂性分类。两个成员资格问题是△₂^P-完全的，唯一性问题也是△₂^P-完全的，而计数最优委员会的问题是#OptP-完全的。这表明这些问题不仅计算困难，而且其难度精确对应于优化问题中的第二层多项式层次，远超普通的NP难问题，揭示了即使找到一个最优委员会后，理解其全局结构依然极其复杂。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 证明的核心是精巧的归约构造，将逻辑问题（如带指定比特的字典序最大满足性）转化为选举实例。关键技术是利用调和数的精细刻度来编码二元目标函数，并通过子句选民确保所有满足赋值获得相同基础分，再用奖励选民以小于1的分数差异区分不同赋值。中国剩余定理用于高效实现所需的分数权重，从而在多项式规模内精确控制最优解的结构。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 论文聚焦一般情形下的最坏情况复杂性，其构造虽具理论深度，但涉及的大整数和特制选民可能偏离现实选举场景。然而，其价值在于首次为PAV最优集的结构性问题提供了完整的复杂性刻画。最值得阅读的是其创新的归约方法，它展示了如何用投票规则编码复杂的优化行为，这对社会选择理论和计算复杂性交叉领域的研究具有重要启发意义。

papers.title: Length Generalization for Transformers via Compression
papers.titleZh: 通过压缩实现Transformer的长度泛化
papers.abstract: Recent advancements in transformer length generalization theory enable us to reliably predict when a transformer can learn to solve a task. In particular, the C-RASP hypothesis (a formalized version of the so-called RASP-l conjecture) posits that transformers length-generalize on a task if and only if a solution is expressible in the C-RASP language. While this hypothesis has strong empirical validation, theoretical problems arise from the fact that no computable length generalization bounds exist for C-RASP, alongside the discovery of seemingly contradictory experiments. To address these problems, we refine the C-RASP hypothesis utilizing the recently-proposed fragments C-RASP+ and C-RASP1. These fragments have computable length generalization bounds, though in the worst case requiring an extremely large (double exponential) sample size. It is an open question whether these sample size bounds are tight. In this paper, we resolve this open question by providing an exponentially tighter bound. In doing so, we show a polynomial length generalization bound for transformers if we adopt compressed strings, via a novel connection to power words. As an application, we show how this yields a fine-grained analysis of the C-RASP conjecture that resolves contradicting experimental evidence against it.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 为什么Transformer在训练后难以可靠地处理比训练数据更长的序列？现有理论认为，只要任务能用C-RASP语言表达，Transformer就能实现长度泛化，但该理论缺乏样本量和输入长度的具体边界，导致无法解释为何某些可表达任务（如受限奇偶性）仍难泛化。问题核心在于理论预测与实际训练效率之间的脱节。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 论文研究的是Transformer在形式语言识别任务上的长度泛化能力。输入是字符串，输出是其是否属于某语言的二元判断。模型基于C-RASP及其子片段C-RASP+和C-RASP1进行建模，通过分析公式大小与所需训练样本的关系来评估泛化难度，并在不同k值下的COUNTk、MAJk和PARITYk任务上验证理论预测。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文提出了基于‘幂词’压缩的新型分析框架，首次给出了C-RASP+和C-RASP1的多项式压缩长度复杂度，从而将样本量上界从双指数级改进为单指数级。这一结果解释了为何PARITYk需要远多于COUNTk或MAJk的样本才能泛化，精细区分了看似同属C-RASP但实际训练难度迥异的任务，解决了原有理论与实验矛盾的问题。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者的关键方法是引入‘幂词’作为压缩表示，将原需极长字符串才能区分的语言实例压缩为短表示。通过将C-RASP+和C-RASP1公式转化为反向有界计数自动机，再映射到整数VASS模型，利用数论中的解稀疏性定理证明存在短接受路径，从而得出压缩后的小长度复杂度，最终推出更紧的样本复杂度上界。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 论文仅适用于C-RASP+和C-RASP1片段，不涵盖所有C-RASP可定义任务，且指数级样本需求在现实中仍可能过高。然而，其将压缩思想引入长度泛化分析的视角极具启发性。最值得读的是其理论推导部分，尤其是如何通过幂词连接形式语言与压缩表示，为理解Transformer泛化提供了新工具。

papers.title: The BatchNorm Illusion: Diagnosing Normalization Artifacts in Machine Unlearning Evaluation
papers.titleZh: BatchNorm 误区：诊断机器遗忘评估中的归一化伪影
papers.abstract: Approximate machine unlearning aims to remove the influence of specific training data from a trained model without retraining from scratch. We identify a previously undocumented confound in how unlearning is evaluated on BatchNorm-based architectures: a single forward pass over retain data, an operation that modifies no weight, can deterministically rewrite the model's normalization state and reverse the apparent surface-metric forgetting. We formalize this operation as a weight-preserving fixed-point operator and prove that any pre-versus-post gap it induces is provably attributable to BN running statistics rather than to any modification the unlearning method made to the weights. This attribution claim cleanly separates measurement failure (BN artifact) from encoder failure (residual weight-encoded information, recently documented in concurrent work), and the same operator framework yields a unique decomposition of linear-probe elevation into BN-measurement-bias and encoder-geometry components. Empirically, the artifact reverses headline forget accuracy by up to 78 pp across nine evaluated methods on standard benchmarks; an attacker with as few as 10 unlabeled images recovers most of the masked accuracy; and a strict GroupNorm control reduces the artifact to zero across all methods. The tested membership-inference attacks change little under recalibration, locating the observed evaluation failure in forget accuracy and linear probing.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 机器遗忘旨在从已训练模型中移除特定数据的影响，但当前评估常依赖表面准确率，可能误判真实遗忘效果。本文指出，在使用BatchNorm的模型中，即使权重未变，仅因归一化统计量失配，就能制造出‘已被遗忘’的假象。这导致现有评估不可靠，核心问题在于无法区分是参数真正清除了信息，还是仅因归一化状态异常而暂时抑制了表现。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 研究聚焦于分类任务下的机器遗忘场景，模型采用带BatchNorm的ResNet等架构，目标是遗忘一个或多个类别。评估不仅看遗忘类准确率，还结合线性探针、重学习攻击等辅助指标。关键设定是引入‘重校准’操作：在保留数据上运行一次前向传播以更新BatchNorm的运行统计量，观察此操作前后各项指标的变化，从而分离归一化与权重编码的影响。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文揭示了一种普遍存在的‘BatchNorm错觉’：六项主流遗忘方法在重校准后遗忘准确率飙升最高达78个百分点，表明其表面遗忘实为伪影。同时发现，攻击者仅用10张无标签图像即可恢复大部分遗忘能力。严格的GroupNorm对照实验使该效应归零，证实其根源在BatchNorm。结果颠覆了对许多方法有效性的认知，强调需修正评估标准。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 核心方法是定义‘重校准算子’，证明其为保持权重不变的不动点操作，任何前后差异必源于归一化状态而非权重修改。由此建立理论框架，将线性探针提升分解为‘归一化测量偏置’与‘编码器几何’两部分。前者反映评估偏差，后者才是真实残留信息。该机制解释了为何某些方法看似成功实则泄露严重，提供了可解释的归因工具。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 局限在于主要验证于图像分类与类级遗忘，对实例级遗忘或语言模型（使用LayerNorm）影响较小。虽通过ViT和GroupNorm控制验证归一化特异性，但未涵盖所有架构。评测范围集中于准确率与线性探针，成员推断攻击变化不大。最值得读的是其对评估体系的根本性质疑与提出的诊断框架，这对未来可信的机器遗忘研究具有指导意义。

papers.title: SUN: Reaching for Novelty in Reinforcement Learning
papers.titleZh: SUN: 在强化学习中追求新颖性
papers.abstract: Exploration in reinforcement learning (RL) remains a fundamental challenge. Recent goal-conditioned RL strategies (which select goals to encourage broader state coverage) have shown promising results, but none scores a goal by novelty and reachability jointly: the two signals are traded off by hand, applied in sequence, or one is neglected outright. In this paper, we introduce a reachability-aware goal-selection framework that explicitly integrates these two aspects, and that can be seamlessly incorporated into any off-policy RL algorithm. To this aim, we propose SUccessor-to-Novelty (SUN), an indicator derived from successor value functions to identify goals that are both novel and reachable. We prove that SUN recovers count-based bonuses in the limit, bounds short-horizon hitting probabilities, and provably rejects unreachable goals. We further present an adaptive goal-selection strategy that leverages these properties, and an accurate yet lightweight pseudocount to avoid the overhead of classic methods. We back up all our claims with thorough benchmarks: SUN consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in standard and novel environments with unreachable or hard-to-reach states, irreversible transitions, obstacles, mazes, and unbounded spaces.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 强化学习中的探索效率长期受限于如何平衡‘去新地方’和‘去能到达的地方’这两个相互冲突的目标。现有方法要么只关注状态的新颖性而忽略是否可达，导致盲目尝试；要么只优化可达性而陷入已知区域。本文指出，真正有效的探索应同时考虑新颖性和可达性，并揭示当前主流方法在这两者之间的权衡缺乏原则性整合。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 论文研究的是无奖励前提下的目标条件强化学习（GCRL）中的探索问题。模型通过从回放缓冲区采样候选目标，结合可达性信号（基于后继值函数）和新颖性信号（基于轻量伪计数）进行目标选择。实验在多种环境中评估覆盖率和访问熵，涵盖不可达状态、迷宫、非均匀初始分布等挑战，以验证方法在复杂探索场景下的有效性。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文提出了SUN框架，其核心贡献是将新颖性与可达性统一在一个乘积形式的选择准则中，实现了无需调参的自动平衡。实验表明，SUN在各类环境中均显著优于AdaGoal和DISCOVER等前沿方法，尤其在存在不可达状态或狭窄通道的场景下表现突出，证明了联合建模的有效性，并提供了关于探索目标选择的新见解。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: SUN的关键在于定义了一个名为‘后继至新颖性’（SUN）的指标，它是后继值函数与伪计数倒数的乘积。该设计使得无法到达的目标得分为零，从而被自然过滤；同时引入自适应目标重选机制，在后继值下降时重新选择目标，避免被困于不可达目标。此外，采用固定半径近邻的轻量伪计数，使计算开销降至O(1)，支持高频查询。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: SUN依赖计数型新颖性信号，在高维观测空间（如图像）中可能失效，因大多数状态天然唯一。此外，目标选择仅基于终点新颖性，未考虑路径上的潜在收益。尽管如此，其机制设计清晰、理论性质良好，非常值得阅读。最值得细读的是其方法论部分，尤其是SUN指标的设计原理及其与计数奖励的等价性证明。

papers.title: Transformers as In-Context Samplers: From Closed-Form Diffusion to Estimation-Free Sampling
papers.titleZh: Transformers 作为上下文内采样器：从闭式扩散到无估计采样
papers.abstract: A growing body of work establishes that large language models are not mere statistical memorizers, but are capable of in-context learning: performing inference at test time using only examples provided in the prompt, without any parameter updates. Prior theoretical work has shown that this capability extends to supervised learning tasks such as linear regression. We prove that in-context learning extends further to \emph{data generation}: frozen transformers can simulate iterative generative samplers from in-context samples. We first show that transformers can realize closed-form and smoothed closed-form diffusion samplers. The construction identifies a concrete generative role for softmax attention: it computes responsibility weights and weighted empirical averages, while feedforward layers implement Euler updates. To empirically relate these constructions to pretrained language models, we study \emph{semantic-topic sampling}: prompts consisting of words drawn from a common semantic category, such as animals, foods, or cities. Across transformer layers, the normalized hidden states exhibit a two-stage geometry: they move toward a uniform spherical reference in intermediate layers and then return to structured, topic-dependent representations near the output. We further measure an interacting-particle energy on these hidden-state clouds and observe the same U-shape pattern. We then prove that transformers can approximate an energy-based sampler, constructing the same U-shape energy across the layers.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 传统观点认为大语言模型通过参数更新适应新任务，但实证显示其能在不更新参数的情况下通过提示中的示例进行推理，即上下文学习。此前研究集中于分类或回归等条件生成任务，而本文追问：冻结的Transformer能否仅凭上下文样本，在无显式训练的情况下模拟完整的生成过程？这挑战了模型仅靠记忆或模式匹配的传统认知。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 研究设定为从独立同分布样本中生成新样本的无条件生成任务。输入是来自未知分布的样本序列及其嵌入，输出是一个新样本向量。模型使用标准Transformer架构，通过自注意力和前馈层在固定参数下完成采样。评估结合理论构造与实证分析，观察预训练模型在语义类别提示下的隐状态演化，并测量其与均匀球面分布的偏离程度。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文证明冻结的Transformer可模拟闭式扩散和无估计采样（EFS）两类生成算法。关键发现是预训练模型的隐状态在中间层趋向均匀球面分布，随后恢复结构化语义，呈现U形动态。该模式与EFS的能量演化一致，表明模型内部存在先平滑后重构的生成机制，为上下文学习的生成能力提供了统一解释。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 方法核心在于揭示Softmax注意力可计算加权责任权重并实现加权均值，前馈层则执行欧拉更新，从而模拟扩散过程。对于EFS，模型被构造为先最小化粒子间相互作用能量使分布均匀，再反向最大化能量以生成新样本。理论证明依赖于注意力机制对高斯混合责任权重的精确建模与迭代更新的逐层实现。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 理论结果展示表达能力而非训练模型实际执行的算法，实验证据虽支持U形动态，但无法唯一确定内部机制。小规模模型中该效应较弱，暗示深度影响计算完整性。最值得读的是其将生成过程形式化为上下文内迭代采样的新视角，以及连接注意力机制与物理粒子系统的创新分析框架。

papers.title: A Closed-Form Estimator and Diagnostic Battery for Anchor-Judge Error Correlation, Under a Single-Common-Factor Model
papers.titleZh: 单共同因子模型下锚定评判者误差相关性的闭式估计量与诊断套件
papers.abstract: When an external reference set (an anchor) is used to decompose an LLM-judge panel's error into a quality signal and a shared common-mode error, standard practice assumes the anchor is uncontaminated: its error uncorrelated with the judges' shared error. We study when that assumption can be dropped and replaced by an estimate. Under a single-common-factor model, >=2 judges and >=2 anchors point-identify the quality variance, the common-mode variance, and each anchor's contamination correlation rho_k in closed form, with an exact per-anchor-pair failure boundary; a designated clean-anchor estimator, by contrast, reports a contaminated companion anchor as fully clean once its trusted anchor is itself contaminated. Because the single-common-factor assumption is itself untestable, the estimator ships gated behind a calibrated diagnostic battery (judge-covariance dispersion; over-identification; a family-block test from judge metadata, with a family-blocked estimator that removes family-level shared-residual bias exactly), bootstrap confidence intervals with measured coverage, and a weak-identification screen. A proposition maps which violations bias rho_k, in which direction, and which evade detection. For ordinal scores we show an identification hierarchy: with all variables ordinal, rho_k is not identified at any number of anchors; with ordinal judges and >=3 continuous anchors it is, and we give an estimator for that case. On real data the validation is asymmetric, and we say so plainly: the diagnostics are validated in the rejecting direction (both real panels we test are correctly rejected by the model-adequacy pre-test), while the estimator is validated in simulation and stress-tested semi-synthetically under oracle calibration; no real panel has yet passed the pre-test, and the pre-test exists precisely to say so. All results replay offline from shipped, checksummed artifacts.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 当前大语言模型（LLM）作为评判者的评估体系常因评委间共享偏差导致误差无法通过平均消除，现有方法依赖外部锚定集并假设其无污染，但若锚与评委共享偏见则结果不可靠。本文指出这一清洁锚假设常不成立，核心问题是缺乏对锚污染程度的可识别测量与可信检验手段，尤其在真实评测中难以验证模型前提。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 研究设定基于单共同因子模型，将评委与锚的评分分解为质量信号与共享误差项，输入为多个评委和多个锚对同一组项目的打分，输出为各锚的污染相关系数pk及质量方差等参数。通过≥2评委与≥2锚即可识别，无需清洁锚假设，并引入三项诊断测试评估模型适配性，所有结果均基于模拟或真实数据上的统计推断。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文提出了首个无需清洁锚假设的闭式估计量，能直接解析计算锚污染程度，并精确刻画识别失效边界。配套的三重校准诊断套件可检测常见模型误设，仿真显示估计量在合理样本下表现稳健，而在真实人类与LLM评测面板上，诊断测试均拒绝模型适配，表明当前多数面板尚不满足应用条件。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 方法利用评委协方差矩阵的结构特性，在单共同因子假设下建立可观测矩与潜参之间的显式映射，导出pk的闭式解。诊断体系包括评委协方差离散度检验、超识别检验与基于元数据的家庭区块检验，分别捕捉非均匀加载与家族级残差偏差。Bootstrap置信区间与弱识别筛查保障推断可靠性。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 最大局限在于尚未在通过模型适配检验的真实面板上验证估计量，目前所有实证面板均被诊断拒绝，故估计结果仍属理论可用状态。此外，均匀加载的第二因子虽不影响pk估计却会膨胀质量方差，且面板级残差无法检测。最值得阅读的是其严谨的问题抽象、清晰的识别边界分析与实用的诊断框架设计。
